capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: The mirrored line and ellipse are prepared by production handlers before capture; playback shows a synthetic ORBIT cursor and persistent no-pressure disclosure.

encoding.gif: In-app screenshot frames downscaled to 640x360; image GIF encoder without a loop extension (plays once); 10 fps; 6 seconds; <=5 MiB.
encoding.mp4: Captured full-viewport RGBA frames; Blender H.264 fallback; 10 fps.
encoding.poster: First full-resolution app frame encoded as PNG.

input_note: The mirrored line and ellipse are prepared by production handlers before capture. Captured PenSample orbit input uses pressure=None and no tilt; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Procedurally generated from an empty Sketch3D document through the production line-mirror and shape handlers; no external artwork or assets.

poster.alt: An editable cyan mirrored line pair and ellipse on Sketch3D's front drawing guide.

review.notes: Synthetic mirror-shapes draft. The mirrored line and ellipse are prepared through production handlers before the captured orbit; review playback and readability before use.

shot_steps: Create a straight line and its reflected run through the production live-mirror line handler.
Create an editable ellipse on the front drawing guide through the production shape handler.
Orbit the camera using synthetic barrel samples through canvas_input.
